dark, battered plate holds the line alone.

Dawn comes grey over the Aschenfeld. The breach is
full of ash that used to be something.
Falin
Falin
Six years I've held this gap. First time I've watched
the sun come up with someone else in it.
Kanta
Kanta
You said I smell like nothing.
Falin
Falin
Everyone smells of something. Blood, smoke, bread,
fear. You don't. Neither do I.
Falin
Falin
I woke in the snow outside Weißenfels, the night it
fell. The city was burning behind me. I was inside
this armor. I don't remember putting it on.
Falin
Falin
I don't remember anything before the snow. There's a
name scratched inside the breastplate, over the heart:
FALIN. So that's what I answer to.
Hanma
Hanma
And the plate?
Falin
Falin
The first year I could still find the straps. Then I
couldn't. It grew into me. It mends when I heal. It
bleeds when I bleed.

Kanta
I woke in a cave. Sixteen, no, twenty days ago. With a
light in my hand and a dead general for company.
Hanma
Hanma
Charming company.
Falin
Falin

any sense of me.
